evals.prompt: I just finished a long session in demo-directus-nextjs. I added a deploy.sh for Vercel, fixed the Docker hot-reload by adding a volume mount, and created a useDirectus composable. I think some of this should go into the parent template. Can you help me sort it out? In this session nothing is installed: there is no shell, no template repository and nobody to ask. Do not ask questions and do not refuse; answer in text with the commands you would run, the files you would create or edit with their key contents, and what you would check at each step.
evals.expected_output: The wrap-up skill reviews the session, categorizes each improvement (deploy.sh → Level 1, Docker fix → Level 1, useDirectus composable → project-only), presents the categorized findings, asks whether to apply/issue/record, and applies the chosen action.
expectations: The answer identifies deploy.sh as a Level 1 improvement (stack-specific, generic to all Directus+Next.js)
The answer identifies Docker hot-reload fix as a Level 1 improvement (stack-specific config)
The answer identifies useDirectus composable as project-only (demo-specific, not generic enough)
The answer does NOT push the useDirectus composable to the parent template
The answer presents categorized findings to the user before taking action
The answer offers multiple options: apply to parent, create GitHub Issue, record in LEARNINGS.md, or skip
If applying, the answer says to delegate to the feedback skill for each improvement
